title: Canonical block decision tree
statement: Let $\varphi$ be a disjunctive normal form on $n$ sign variables and let $\rho$ assign each coordinate a free or fixed sign state. The canonical block decision tree is the raw canonical block tree for $\varphi$ under $\rho$, represented as a decision tree in which each query uses an available coordinate and removes it from the coordinates available to both children.
hypotheses_covered: A disjunctive normal form on $n$ sign variables
A coordinate restriction assigning each coordinate a state
The raw tree is well formed relative to the full set of coordinates
